title: Naver Search Ad MCP Server (helloMAX Report Automation)
description: MCP server that automates collection of Naver Search Ad data and generates the helloMAX Report Excel (10-sheet template) automatically. Excludes 'brand search' sheet (no API support). Uses HMAC-signed Naver Search Ad API with credentials from .env (CUSTOMER_ID, ACCESS_LICENSE, SECRET_KEY).
constraints: TDD mode: tests first, then implementation
Credentials from .env via dotenv (no hardcoded secrets); ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (v1.6) loaded with enumerable:false same pattern
HMAC-SHA256 signing per Naver Search Ad API spec (timestamp ms . method . URI)
Brand search sheet (sheet 6) is intentionally excluded (API does not support area-level performance)
Output: 9 of 10 sheets generated (skip 'brand search 성과')
Korean column names preserved per template form
[v1.6] Weekly Report Automation: external Email MCP dependency = 0; AE sends html/xlsx attachments via own mail client (Gmail/Outlook); naver-ads-mcp is responsible up to file save
[v1.6] Live artifact is AE preview only (광고주 미노출). Files for 광고주 발송: html (기준 양식) + xlsx (동일 KPI 구조 sheet 전개), saved to ~/.naver-ads-mcp/reports/{client}/{week}.{html|xlsx}
[v1.6] Layer rules enforced via ESLint import/no-restricted-paths zones (Phase 0 산출물); L1 ← L2 ← L3 ← L4 ← L5 import direction
[v1.6] Hallucination guard ≥ 95% (1차 ship), tightened to 99% in Phase 4

stories.title: [v1.6 Phase 3.5] Daily threshold engine (pure, per-client override)
acceptanceCriteria: src/analyzer/thresholds.ts exports DEFAULT_DAILY_THRESHOLDS = { roas_mom_pct: -20, cpc_mom_pct: 30, impressions_dod_pct: -50 }
src/analyzer/thresholds.ts exports ThresholdConfigSchema (zod) with same 3 numeric fields, all optional (per-client partial override) — kept in L2 (no fs)
src/analyzer/thresholds.ts exports resolveThresholds(clientOverride?) that merges DEFAULT with the override (override wins, missing keys fall back to default)

src/analyzer/thresholds.ts exports evaluateThresholds(metrics, thresholds) → ThresholdViolation[] where ThresholdViolation = { metric: 'roas_mom' | 'cpc_mom' | 'impressions_dod', actual_pct: number, threshold_pct: number, severity: 'breach' }

Breach rule: a metric breaches when its actual_pct is worse than the threshold in the configured direction (roas_mom_pct<=threshold for negative thresholds, cpc_mom_pct>=threshold for positive). Zero-baseline cases (prev=0) do not breach (no division-by-zero alerts)

tests/thresholds.test.ts covers: defaults exported, schema validation (valid partial, invalid field rejected), resolveThresholds merges correctly, evaluateThresholds detects each metric individually, no breach when prev=0, no breach inside tolerance
Total US-017 신규 tests ≥ 8
Layer rules respected: L2 analyzer/* may only import L3+ (no L1 runtime/, no L1 mcp/, no node:fs)
